blocks.text: Basing from the survey which was conducted in 2003, about 33 percent of the people in the country with ages 14 to 23 years old had abused methadone for recreational purposes. Thus, this clearly means that a huge part of this figure could be suffering from methadone addiction.

blocks.text: In 1999, a city in Vancouver has had 170 patients with methadone addiction case and most of them are men. As of the present days, more than 3000 patients in Vancouver are struggling with methadone addiction. Getting addicted to this drug is easy because all pharmacies in the country can dispense it to customers that carry a prescription. With the legality of this drug in the country, it is alarming to note that addiction can easily happen to all those who are using methadone in treating their illnesses.

blocks.text: In Quebec, many people are also tagged as methadone addicts. In 2002 alone, there were less than two thousand people who were on methadone. People who were living in the streets of Montreal were also subjected to a methadone survey and 8 percent of them have admitted that they have used the drug at least once in their lives.

blocks.text: Methadone, when used as an addiction treatment can create a strong and persistent addiction more often than not. It can be clearly pictured this way: using the drug to solve a problem is something that creates another one. And when one becomes addicted to this drug, he will suffer from different signs and symptoms like constipation, drowsiness, etc. And when one abuses this drug in a frequent manner, it can cause dangerous effects such as respiratory problems.
